summary_1line: As the Bhagavad Gita begins, Duryodhana surveys the armies, conches sound, and Arjuna asks Krishna to place his chariot between the forces, then falters in grief.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna halts the white-horsed chariot between the two vast armies while Arjuna, bow in hand, gazes at rows of his own relatives on the battlefield.
Bhishma, the aged grandsire, stands in armor and blows his conch with a lion-like roar as drums and horns thunder across Kurukshetra.
Overwhelmed with pity, Arjuna trembles in his chariot as the Gandiva bow slips from his hand while he looks upon fathers, teachers, and friends among the enemy ranks.
